_coverageThresholdRationale: Floors were recalibrated after the Community Web client extraction: the old 85/85 line and statement floors were set when the web surfaces were single emitted template-literal modules, so their giant style/markup strings counted as covered lines and inflated the totals. The vite-compiled client entry (Epoch.Community.Web/dist/client/*) executes only inside Playwright and is invisible to c8, so it is excluded with the workbench/search bundles. Remaining Node-visible actuals after that exclude sit near 90/87/78 for lines/functions/branches. Floors sit 1-2 points below those actuals and ratchet up when fuzz/history commands cover more Change Graph fail-closed paths.
